we proposed a novel subspace discovery based framework for attributed network representation learning.

(i) we propose a novel subspace transformation method for attributed network embedding that is capable of handling sparse content and incomplete attributes; (ii) we formulate an optimization problem to learn the transformation parameters; (iii) we design a stochastic gradient descent algorithm to solve the optimization problem, with linear time-complexity to the number of network nodes; (iv) we conduct extensive experiments to evaluate the proposed method, which shows superior performance to the state-of-the-art methods on various tasks.
